ratio-test-ratios.alt: Dots at height (n + 1) squared over 3 n squared for n = 1 to 15, the ratio of consecutive terms of the series of n squared over 3 to the n. The first dot is at 4/3, above a solid line at 1; the rest fall below it and approach a dashed line at 1/3. The limit 1/3 is below 1, so the series converges.
